Guardian cannot write audit_log on PostgreSQL (policy_rules_cited json string into text[], created_at ISO string into timestamptz): run the backend integration suite against Postgres in CI and fix every failure

Rejecting a draft needs a Guardian REJECTED verdict, so a human reject works only while /check reads the situation as DISORDER (PR-006); a classified reject request is refused. Decide the reject authority (e.g. an APPROVED verdict for action GOVERNANCE_REJECT on the subject) and pin it
Interventions: a non-UUID id now reaches PostgreSQL uuid columns and errors (500); validate ids at the API (422) and test it
MCP tools/list is at 54,504 of its 55,000-byte budget and output schemas embed CausalQuery, so each new contract field eats it: slim output schemas (refs, not inlined models) or justify a new budget
seed_data.py --clear issues a DELETE on causal_entities with columns that do not exist, and must run as the owner (causal_app cannot DELETE); fix and document

next 16 + eslint-config-next 16 together, as one change: #19 (next 16.3.6 alone) was green in the gate and the image build; #20 (eslint-config-next 16 alone, next 15) crashed eslint 9.39 (TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON, plugins.react), so the two move together; drop the root overrides.next.postcss (^8.5.28, there only for next 15's nested postcss 8.4.31) once npm audit is clean without it (next 16.3.6 pins postcss 8.5.23); replace the 'next lint' script (removed in 16); fix next.config.ts experimental.typedRoutes -> typedRoutes

TypeScript 7 (#21, 5.9.3 -> 7.0.2): tsc reports one error over 50 files, TS2882 side-effect import './globals.css' in src/app/layout.tsx (needs a *.css module declaration); and next 15's build fails loading next.config.ts (TypeError: reading 'fileExists' -- TS 7 has no JS compiler API), so it waits for a next that supports TS 7 (after the next 16 item) or keeps typescript 5 for next

Frontend image to node 26 when it becomes LTS (October 2026): #15 proposed 26-alpine (green) while 26 is Current, not LTS; the image is on node 24 LTS; lift the '>=25' docker ignore in .github/dependabot.yml, rebuild, smoke-test and Trivy-judge the image

'Redis cache for production' comments with no Redis client (contracts.py, ADR-002, seed_data.py) and the bare 'platform.drift.alert.v1' topic label: reword or drop

Real provenance erasure (e.g. per-subject encryption with key deletion) for gdpr-controls; the tombstone only hides

Confirm the T9 published-example values (Rosenbaum 2002 Table 4.3, Morton lead pairs) against a physical copy; they match DOS2 senWilcox to 4 decimals

_run_graph's exception fallbacks synthesise a verdict with no audit record: write an unsigned history row saying why
